notes.title: Vehicles, garage and static weapons!
notes.content:
Rev up your engines and fasten your seatbelts because today, we're introducing some thrilling new features to Lost in the Sand!

[h1]Vehicles and Garage[/h1]

Introducing vehicles as a core gameplay mechanic! 

Customize and upgrade your fleet to dominate the sands. Install new engines, parts, and armor plates to optimize your vehicles for battle. From sleek speedsters to armored behemoths, build the ultimate war machines to crush your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/1f1503d6692126376106432989ee7327fcc5f1c1.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Key Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Vehicles introduced as a core gameplay mechanic.
[*] Customize and upgrade your fleet with new engines, parts, and armor plates for strategic advantage.
[/list]

[h1]AI Vehicles[/h1]

Experience the helpful hand of AI with our latest vehicle improvements! 

AI-characters now possess the ability to drive vehicles, navigate rough terrain, and even unflip them if needed. Witness their dedication as they make their way to the garage for repairs and refueling when needed. 

No more vehicles stuck in sand - our AI drivers are here to lend a helping "wheel" on the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/5fc24172e5a3972592a729a5416377d692b2db20.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Key Features:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] NPCs have the ability to drive vehicles.
[*] AI-controlled vehicles make their way to the garage for maintenance and refueling.
[/list]

[h1]New Static Weapons[/h1]

Prepare for chaos with our arsenal of new static weapons!

[h2]Lead Spread:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/c41b10d51f8aea1ec486e49a71ce70c5ead892f6.jpg[/img]
Unleash a hail of bullets with the Lead Spread! This high-rate machine gun may lack accuracy but excels at suppressing enemies and keeping them on their toes.

[h2]Life Extinguisher:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/f73eb857f7246cd292dd012c757f69c4bff68c94.jpg[/img]
Turn up the heat with the Life Extinguisher! This rocket launcher sends projectiles soaring into the sky before raining down like a fiery meteor shower, engulfing your enemies in flames.

[h2]Dune Splitter:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/17edfe058c4dbe3231079cbdb3deed0b20226c45.jpg[/img]

Unleash devastation with the Dune Splitter! This heavyweight champion of firepower hits like a freight train, boasting unparalleled destructive capabilities. Its massive cannon fires water jugs filled with explosives, decimating anything in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/7d9468d2d9e1573d5b9bf3227349c558825f6668.jpg[/img]

These powerful additions will revolutionize your strategy on the battlefield. Choose your weapon wisely and dominate the sands!

[h1]Artillery Computer[/h1]

Take aim with precision using our artillery computer! This advanced targeting system is specifically designed to help with aiming the Life Extinguisher. Plan your shots strategically and rain down fiery destruction on your enemies with pinpoint accuracy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/f296b729fa806b0e13911e38397a300afb9f06a0.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Key Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Precision targeting system for the Life Extinguisher static weapon.
[*] Support for future artillery weapons.
[/list]

[h1]Stay Connected![/h1]

Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey as we develop Lost in the Sand! Your support means the world to us.

Keep an eye out for more updates as we continue to bring this game to life. Join our community, share your feedback, and let's build something incredible together.

In the meantime, make sure to check out the latest devlog, cheers!

[previewyoutube=Uk4JkP_F-Fg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Squad Commanding and Crafting Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Squad Commanding System Upgrade[/h1]

Dive into the heart of battle with the enhanced Squad UI!

Get to know your team better – from their name and squad index to their current weapon and stance. 

Keep a close eye on the action as squad members dynamically adjust their stance, when forced by enemy suppressive fire. 

Stay informed whether your squad is following you or adhering to a specific move/stop order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/bbed77de87c1262d193e6a5c39a59b570fc77139.jpg[/img]

[u]Key Features:[/u]

[list]
[*] Dynamic stance adjustments based on combat situations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/c81716b3d88055b0020d8562b05835f179c6367b.jpg[/img][*] Efficient tracking of squad following and orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/d3284cee9993716eec762413fab2fe32850a0dd2.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Direct Control with the New Ordering System[/h2]

Take charge like never before. Directly control your squad members with a variety of commands: move, follow, stop, change formation, and shift stances.

Seamless control over both your squad and others.

[u]Key Features:[/u]

[list]
[*] Direct commands for move, follow, stop, change formation, and stance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/7315fc001c8d25e19af32b5e768431fd0580b55f.jpg[/img]
[*] Seamless control over both your squad and others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/b95e3fa33b66cf62022bbf89ab684ce724910f4f.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Crafting Minigame[/h1]

Gear up for an interactive experience with the all-new Crafting Minigame! Immerse yourself in a series of animations as disassembled weapons come to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/05dcf3a4fc8fbd54fd2eaebd1a3e51a3a44dba7a.jpg[/img]

Immerse yourself in the crafting process with intuitive on-screen prompts. 

Witness the placement of the gun barrel and experience the satisfying screwing motion as your weapon comes together. 

Each crafted item boasts a unique animation, turning crafting into an engaging and personalized journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864746/66163f582d718692e938548550c69f4ab022633f.jpg[/img]

[u]Key Features:[/u]

[list]
[*] Unique weapon animations for a personalized crafting experience.
[*] Interactive crafting prompts for involvement.
[/list]

Get ready to feel the thrill of these game-changing updates in Lost in the Sand! 

Your squad awaits your command, and the crafting bench is ready for your skilled hands. Stay tuned for diving into the action and exploring the enhanced squad features! 

In the meantime feel free to share your thoughts with us!

notes.title: New fresh look for the game!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I've spent the last couple of weeks developing a brand new art style for the game. Thanks to a lot of hard work and the assistance of some friends, it is finally finished and I'm excited to share it with you!

[h2]Models[/h2]
This new art style is helping the game in achieving a cartoonish style while also allowing the models to stand out and show the amount of work that was put into them.

Here's a comparison of how the game looked before and after this update:
